name: Question 10
problem:

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}{e}^{uv} \\ u+2v\end{aligned}].
$$

Question 10
?

Find the locations of all of the critical points of T, where T is defined as

T:[uv]⟶[euvu+2v].

a
The critical points lie on the hyperbola uv=ln⁡2.
b
The critical points lie on the line u=−2v.
c
The critical points lie on the line u=2v.
d
The critical points lie on the line v=−2u.
e
The critical points lie on the line v=2u.
